sn22.21:1.2: Then the Venerable Ānanda approached the Blessed One, paid homage to him, sat down to one side, and said to him:
sn22.21:1.4: Through the cessation of what things is cessation spoken of?”
sn22.21:1.5: “Form, Ānanda, is impermanent, conditioned, dependently arisen, subject to destruction, to vanishing, to fading away, to cessation.
sn22.21:1.6: Through its cessation, cessation is spoken of.
sn22.21:1.12: Consciousness is impermanent, conditioned, dependently arisen, subject to destruction, to vanishing, to fading away, to cessation.
sn22.21:1.13: Through its cessation, cessation is spoken of.
sn22.21:1.14: “It is through the cessation of these things, Ānanda,
